steps: Press the firm tofu between paper towels 10 minutes, then cut it into 1 cm cubes. Grate the carrot and slice the green onion.
Beat the eggs in a bowl. Use cooked rice that is cold from the fridge; it fries without turning gummy.
Heat half the canola oil in a large pan over medium-high heat, about 1 minute, until it shimmers.
Cook the tofu 6 to 8 minutes, turning, until golden on most sides. Set aside on a plate.
Add the remaining oil and the carrot and cook 2 minutes, until softened. Pour in the eggs and stir 1 minute, until just set.
Add the rice and the green peas and stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes, until the rice is hot and slightly crisp at the edges.
Return the tofu, add the coconut aminos and the green onion, and toss 30 seconds, until coated.
Under 12 months, chop the tofu smaller and skip the crisp edges. Keeps 2 days in the fridge.
